Definition: strength in various applications (force, security, majesty, praise)
BiblicalUsage: Strength is the power of God given to His people. Hannah sang that He shall give strength unto His king, David danced before the Lord with all his might, and Solomon prayed that the ark of God's strength might rest in the temple.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe strength is God's to give: Hannah sang that the Lord gives strength to His king, and David danced before the ark with all his might. My strength is borrowed, and the day I forget that is the day I fall.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
